verdict.rationale: Bolt's docs describe built-in hosting that publishes a project for free to a bolt.host web address, with public or private visibility and optional custom domains. The GitHub README says you can 'Deploy to production from chat', which supports a low-friction, near one-step publish. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that publishing is a single click or step, independent hands-on corroboration of the publish flow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can publish my app to a live URL in one step

citations.quote: Bolt offers built-in hosting, so you can publish your Bolt project for free at a web address ending in `bolt.host`.
you choose whether your site is visible to everyone on the web (public) or only to your team and other people you invite (private)
